skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing [Basic Attack] to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: Hu Wei
skills.desc:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of Might, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for Might is 200.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Tigerwind
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
skills.desc:
Mountain King's Game
After using Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the joystick to move and deal Physical DMG upon contact with enemies.
Mountain King's Game - Momentum
After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Fire DMG and granting 25 points of Might.
Mountain King's Game - Hu Wei
When dealing Fire DMG, if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron.
Releasing [Basic Attack] will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes invulnerable.
*Text broken up and labeled for clarity.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Decisive Stomp
skills.desc:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Steadfast Crouching Tiger
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Feral Blazing Maw
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, then use Hu Wei to follow up with a downward attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 1 point of Momentum upon activation at most once every 10s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Tiger Cauldron Collapse
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron
skills.desc:
With at least 100 points of Might, after triggering a Chain Attack, automatically activate:
Consume 100 Might to open Hu Wei and fire flames and popcorn at enemies, striking them in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Momentum is available, and while not the active character, Fiery Spin will activate after the skill ends. This is an Aftershock. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Fu-rocious Might
skills.desc:
When Ju Fufu isn't using Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain Might upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 Might, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the Tiger's Roar effect: CRIT DMG increases by 10%, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the Tiger's Roar state, character Chain Attack/Ultimate DMG increases by 10%/20%. The Tiger's Roar state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, Impact increases by 25.
*Stats shown are at Base level.
rows: Tiger's Roar: Chain Attack/Ultimate DMG increases

skills.name: Aura of Authority
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character:
The maximum Decibels for all characters in the squad increases by 1000. When an Attack or Rupture character uses an Ultimate, that character gains 300 Decibels.

cons.name: Super Scary Little Tiger
cons.desc: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.

cons.name: Almighty Qingming Warrior
cons.desc: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.

cons.name: Righteous Young Hero
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2.

cons.name: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
cons.desc: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.

cons.name: Unrivaled Almighty Senior
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2.

cons.name: Roar of My Inner Tiger
cons.desc:
Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%.
Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.

rec.sub: 暴击率、攻击力百分比、攻击力、暴击伤害
rec.skill: Core Skill = Chain Attack > EX Special Attack > Assist > Basic Attack = Dodge
